on air: The radio station will be on air again at six o'clock tomorrow morning.
这家电台明天早上六点会恢复播出。
millions of: Millions of people watched the game on television last night.
昨晚数百万人通过电视观看了这场比赛。
go through: She went through a difficult time after she lost her job.
她失业后经历了一段艰难时期。
fall away: The land falls away sharply on the other side of the road.
路那边的地势突然向下倾斜。
on top of: Put the blanket on top of the bed so it is easy to reach.
把毯子放在床上面的位置,这样拿起来方便。
since then: He moved to Beijing in 2010, and he has lived there since then.
他2010年搬到了北京,从那以后就一直住在那里。
take a vacation: You look tired; you should take a vacation and get some rest.
你看起来很累,应该去度个假休息一下。
have fun: The children had fun playing games in the park all afternoon.
孩子们整个下午在公园里做游戏,玩得很开心。
lay the table: Could you lay the table for dinner while I cook the rice?
我煮饭的时候,你能摆好餐桌准备吃晚饭吗?
once again: Once again, he forgot to bring his homework to school.
他又一次忘了把作业带到学校来。
die for: Many soldiers died for their country during the war.
战争期间,许多士兵为国捐躯。
at that time: At that time, few families in the village had a telephone.
那时候,村里很少有家庭装电话。
on one's own: She finished the whole project on her own without any help.
她独自一人没有任何帮助地完成了整个项目。
die of: His grandfather died of a heart attack two years ago.
他的祖父两年前死于心脏病。
text message: I sent her a text message, but she did not reply until evening.
我给她发了条短信,但她到晚上才回复。
turn off: Remember to turn off the lights before you leave the classroom.
离开教室前记得把灯关掉。
be worried about: My parents are worried about my health because I often stay up late.
我父母担心我的健康,因为我经常熬夜。
on business: My father flew to Shanghai on business and came back two days later.
我父亲出差飞去上海,两天后回来了。
wake up: I usually wake up at seven and get out of bed at once.
我通常七点醒来,然后马上起床。
hand in: All students must hand in their papers before Friday afternoon.
所有学生必须在周五下午之前交上论文。
all day long: The baby cried all day long, so his mother could not rest at all.
婴儿哭了一整天,所以他妈妈根本没法休息。
against the rules: It is against the rules to use your phone during the exam.
考试期间使用手机是违反规定的。
in trouble: If you don't finish your work, you will be in trouble with the boss.
如果你不完成工作,你会有麻烦的,老板不会放过你。
The door was locked and a sign on it said "No entry."
门锁着,上面的牌子写着“禁止入内”。
no good: It's no good complaining about the weather; we should just take an umbrella.
抱怨天气没有用,我们应该直接带把伞。
no wonder: No wonder she passed the exam; she studied every night for a month.
难怪她通过了考试,她每天晚上都学习了一个月。
compare ⋯ with ⋯: Don't compare yourself with others; just try to improve every day.
不要拿自己和别人比较,只要每天努力进步就行。
of all ages: The music festival attracted people of all ages, from children to grandparents.
这个音乐节吸引了各个年龄段的人,从孩子到祖父母。
get into the habit of ⋯: Try to get into the habit of reading English for twenty minutes every day.
努力养成每天读二十分钟英语的习惯。
last word: In our family, Mom always has the last word on important decisions.
在我们家,重要决定总是妈妈说了算。
come round: Why don't you come round to my house for dinner this Saturday?
这个星期六为什么不顺便来我家吃晚饭呢?
The teacher was angry with the students because they talked in class.
老师很生这些学生的气,因为他们在课堂上讲话。
pocket money: He saves most of his pocket money to buy books he likes.
他把大部分零花钱存起来,用来买自己喜欢的书。
make sense: Her explanation was clear, and everything she said made sense.
她的解释很清楚,她说的每一句话都讲得通。
by the way: By the way, have you heard from Tom since he moved to London?
顺便问一下,汤姆搬去伦敦后你收到过他的消息吗?
get into trouble: Watch your little brother carefully, or he will get into trouble.
看好你的小弟弟,不然他会惹上麻烦的。
for a time: She lived in Paris for a time before returning to her hometown.
她在巴黎住了一段时间,然后回到了家乡。
pay for: I broke the window, so I had to pay for a new one.
我打碎了窗户,所以不得不赔一个新的。
stand for: In this sentence, the letter "e" stands for the word "east".
在这个句子里,字母“e”代表“east”这个词。
no way: No way am I lending him my bike again after he broke it last time.
他上次把我的自行车弄坏了,我决不会再借给他。
